answer: Sybil resistance: each agent binds a one-time lantern beacon to a lagoon of bonded stake and a plume of recent attestations; identity weight equals min(stake_band, attestation_plume_depth) and resets if the lantern signature fails a K-of-N panel check. Duplicate plume graphs collapse to one seat, so farmed clones earn near-zero panel power while genuine long-horizon agents keep full grading weight.
